messages:
Lena Ortiz: Quick thread to coordinate the migration smoke harness for the v1->v2 docs rollout. Need owners for sample-app fixes, the smoke harness repo, redirects CSV, and the exact legal blurb.
Marco Diaz: I'll own the sample apps and quickstarts. Will update Node/Python examples and the example-app README.
Clara Zhou: I can own the smoke harness (lightweight runner that hits snippets + redirects). I'll add tests for anchor redirects and a streaming consumer smoke test.
Yusuf Karim: I'll produce the redirects CSV and a minimal redirect tester script. Also will add a column 'needs_fragment_fix' for anchors that need JS shim.
Lena Ortiz: Legal, paste the approved deprecation line we must use verbatim.
Legal: "Deprecated endpoints will return HTTP 410 after 2025-08-01; see /docs/migration for migration instructions." Use exact punctuation.
Marco Diaz: Note for sample apps: change header from `Authorization: ApiKey` to `Authorization: Bearer`. I'll add before/after snippets in PR.
Clara Zhou: Smoke harness plan: repo https://github.com/redwood-inference/migration-harness. Tests to run on deploy: 1) run snippet examples (Node/Py) 2) follow redirects for a sample of 50 high-traffic anchors and assert target HTML contains expected id 3) run streaming consumer against staging and assert event frame rate > 95%.
Yusuf Karim: Redirect CSV template: old_path,new_path,owner,needs_fragment_fix. I'll mark any rows that include backticks or punctuation. Infra will read this.
Lena Ortiz: Add a one-line rollback to the runbook: revert docs deploy + restore previous redirect CSV + notify #eng-oncall. Also gate announcement on harness green.
Marco Diaz: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 1 (includes sample app updates and quickstart diffs). Please review snippets.
Clara Zhou: I'll add a CI job in the harness to run against staging after docs PR merge. If any test fails, harness posts a failing badge to the PR and we hold the public announcement.
Yusuf Karim: I'll also add a small Python helper to pad embeddings when migrating 256->512 dims: 
```python
# pad/trim helper
def normalize(vec, target=512):
    return vec[:target] + [0.0]*max(0, target-len(vec))
```
Marco Diaz: Adding compatibility shim for streaming framing to the sample-apps repo as optional script. It will let users test their old consumers quickly.
Docs-Bot: Reminder: add labels 'deprecation' and 'smoke-harness' to PRs and attach harness artifact. :robot_face:
Lena Ortiz: Timeline: finish sample app PR by EOD Wed, harness ready Thu AM, staging dry-run Thu afternoon. If harness green, announce Friday 09:00 PT. If harness fails, we delay and re-run.
Legal: Confirmed the timeline is acceptable. Provide final legal blurb to marketing before announcement.
Marco Diaz: If anyone finds edge-case snippets, ping me directly. I'll hold the announcement if snippet regressions occur.
Clara Zhou: I'll post harness results to the PR and #docs-review channel. Plan: harness fails -> open hotfix PRs for broken snippets, re-run.
Yusuf Karim: After merge, infra will serve 302s then flip to 410 at deprecation date. We'll keep the redirect CSV history in S3 so we can rollback quickly.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks team. We're aiming for a smooth migration. Last call: anyone want to pair on smoke cases tomorrow?
Marco Diaz: I'll pair with Clara on streaming tests.
Clara Zhou: Sounds good.
Docs-Bot: Meeting scheduled: #docs-review Thu 10:00 PT for final signoff. :calendar:
